_comment: Campuses agent-career-discovery must NOT target. Use for cases the automatic guards can't catch: shared multi-entity ATS portals and system-tenant URLs that over-attribute one campus with a whole system's jobs. Names match institutions-master.json (case-insensitive).

skip.name: University of Illinois Springfield
skip.reason: Discovery resolves to illinois.csod.com (U of I SYSTEM Cornerstone tenant, ~67 jobs) which over-attributes the whole system to UIS; UIUC/UIC are scraped separately. UIS's own portal is uis.csod.com?c=uis. Domain guard can't tell csod tenants apart.

skip.name: The Chicago School at Xavier University of Louisiana
skip.reason: thechicagoschool.edu careers is a shared portal serving all Chicago School locations/partnerships; per-entity overrides would replicate the same jobs across every Chicago School entry.
